# Aura Tourism

A public personal-intelligence tourism proposal by Luke Nathan Hayes. Source edition 27 October 2026; web edition 28 October 2026.

This is a proposal, not a booking service, live participant system, official Games programme or claim of partnership. The original source and its 42 distinct linked destinations are preserved. C-Hours are non-monetary recognition of verified voluntary human time. Chosen rest is legitimate. Original material uses the Strange But True Public Source Licence; third-party rights remain separate. This voluntary guide grants no additional reuse or AI-training rights.
